questions.q: What does the wind do to the narrator's kite?
questions.explain: The wind tears the kite from the narrator's hand.

questions.q: What does the narrator do when the wind becomes a tornado?
questions.explain: The narrator runs after his kite when the wind becomes a tornado.

questions.q: What does the narrator think might be happening to his kite?
choices: It is caught in a tree
It is still flying in the sky
questions.explain: The narrator thinks his kite might be still flying in the sky.

questions.q: What happens after the narrator runs after the kite?
choices: it gets caught in a tree
questions.explain: The narrator runs after the kite and it becomes a tornado.

questions.q: What does the narrator feel after the wind stops?
questions.explain: The narrator cannot see their kite and cannot hear the wind anymore.
